label: Kelkoo Group
terms_note: Merchant Center account; Merchant Statistics API token; product feed spec. Free API; CPC billing.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (Merchant Statistics API + product feed; no campaign API) Confidence: **high**.
auth: 2. Generate the Merchant Statistics API token in Merchant Center (TODO(verify)).

endpoints.purpose: reports (clicks, cost, leads by day / product)

fields.name: jwt
fields.help: Merchant Statistics API token (Kelkoo Merchant Center > API Credentials > Create new token; the JWT is shown once), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It reaches every campaign managed by the login.

me.note: There is no account resource; the probe is GET /my-campaigns (the campaigns the token's login manages).

list_campaigns.note: GET /my-campaigns: [{campaignId, campaignName, websiteUrl, country}] for every campaign (one merchant site per country) the token's login manages. Kelkoo campaigns carry no status or budget in this API; `account_id`, `status`, `page` and `limit` are not sent.

get_report.note: GET /category/{campaign_id}?startDate&endDate (both included, up to two years back): clicks and cost per day, category and device for one campaign; campaign_id is REQUIRED. sales and order_value are filled only with Kelkoo Sales Tracking. Yesterday's data may still be compiling. `account_id` is not sent.

not_offered.list_accounts: The token is tied to one login and the API exposes only /my-campaigns, /category, /product and /sales (https://docs.kelkoogroup.com/for-advertisers/merchant-statistics-api/merchant-statistics-resources).
not_offered.update_budget: The Merchant Statistics API is read-only statistics; budgets are managed in the Merchant Center (https://docs.kelkoogroup.com/for-advertisers/merchant-statistics-api/merchant-statistics-resources).
not_offered.pause_resume: No write resource in the Merchant Statistics API (https://docs.kelkoogroup.com/for-advertisers/merchant-statistics-api/merchant-statistics-resources).

evidence: probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
